Consider the semicircle and constant vector field $F$ shown above. Let $C$ be the path where the semicircle is traversed from $A$ to $B.$ Which of the following statements are true?

- ${\int }_{C}F\cdot \text{d}r<0$
- ${\int }_{C}F\cdot \text{d}r=0$
- ${\int }_{-C}F\cdot \text{d}r>0$
